title: Affine local eventual vanishing of ideal-power evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ with inclusion $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ and $P_0=\mathcal O_X$, using the recursive ideal powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let $\mathcal F$ be quasi-coherent. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open with $x\in U$ if and only if $\iota_x$ is surjective. Fix sections $1_n\in P_n(U)$ with $j_n(1_n)=1$ and maps $r_{nm}:P_m\to P_n$ for $n\le m$ with $j_n r_{nm}=j_m$. For every $n$ and $\varphi:P_n\to\mathcal F$ such that $\varphi_U(1_n)=0$, for every affine open $V\subseteq X$ there are $m\ge n$ with $(\varphi r_{nm})|_V=0$. The ambient scheme need not be quasi-compact.

proof.text: Reuse Scheme.Modules.multiplication_range and Scheme.Modules.powers_qc from IdealTimesQuasiCoherentAffineSections via proof-only import all. The multiplication range applies to an arbitrary quasi-coherent structure-module map, without conversion to IdealSheafData. Induct on the recursive powers to compute their inclusion image as J^n, including degree zero. FormalPolynomialPowerLifts gives injectivity of the power inclusions.

proof.text: Reuse Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_of_finiteType from AffineSectionCoverTwistGeneration via proof-only import all. The image ideal J of the finite affine section module is finitely generated. Ideal.FG.pow gives finite generation of J^n; injectivity and the computed inclusion image give finiteness of Gamma(P_n,V), and hence of the image of phi_V.

source.place: Lemma 01PM, injectivity argument, and Lemma 01PQ; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ.

proof.text: For f in J, its germ at any x in D(f) is a unit in the image of the ideal stalk inclusion. Identify the unit-module stalk with the local ring using ideal_module_product_stalk; multiplying the germ preimage by the inverse unit and any desired scalar proves stalk surjectivity. Therefore D(f) is contained in U. On any W contained in U, the restricted one section has power-inclusion image 1. Injectivity of the power inclusion identifies every section s with j_n(s) times that section. Linearity and naturality then show phi_W(s)=0.

source.place: Lemma 01PM, injectivity argument, and Lemma 01PQ; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ.

proof.text: Every element y of the finite image of phi_V restricts to zero on D(f), so basic-open localization supplies a power of f killing y. Reuse AlgebraicGeometry.mem_radical_annihilator_of_pow_torsion from CoherentAffineMapSupportRadical via proof-only import all to put f in the radical of the image annihilator. Thus J is contained in that radical. Mathlib Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg gives k with J^k contained in the annihilator.

source.place: Lemma 01PM, injectivity argument, and Lemma 01PQ; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ.

proof.text: Let m=n+k. Mapping J^k times Gamma(P_n,V) through the injective inclusion j_n gives J^k J^n=J^m. The compatibility equation for the prescribed r implies its affine section image is contained in J^k times Gamma(P_n,V). Linearity and the annihilator containment therefore make phi composed with r zero on every affine section. A quasi-coherent source localizes on basic opens: clearing denominators shows the map zero there because the basic-open scalar is a unit. Cover each subopen of V by basic opens and use sheaf separatedness to prove the morphism over V is zero. This yields m>=n and covers n=0, J=0, and the empty affine open.

lean.statement:
theorem ideal_power_evaluation_affine_eventually_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (one : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, U))
    (r : ∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m →
      ((idealSheafPower ι m).1 ⟶ (idealSheafPower ι n).1))
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (idealSheafPower ι n).2.app U (one n) = (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    (hr : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      r n m h ≫ (idealSheafPower ι n).2 = (idealSheafPower ι m).2) :
    ∀ (V : X.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) (φ : (idealSheafPower ι n).1 ⟶ F),
      φ.app U (one n) = 0 →
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m), (r n m h ≫ φ).over V.1 = 0
